subtitle: Lesson 30 · Monitoring & Cost Management for Training Clusters

eyebrow: No invoice line item answers this

code:
# Namespace-level view, per team
kubectl get pytorchjobs -n training-lm
kubectl get pytorchjobs -n training-mm

# Pod spec drives GPU cost attribution
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 8   # this pod's share of the node's GPU cost
caption: Kubecost attributes a node's GPU cost to the pods that requested those GPUs, proportional to how many each pod asked for.

eyebrow: Not every cost maps to one team
